text: 中国人民银行货币政策司司长谢光启15日在国新办新闻发布会上表示，未来一段时期，货币信贷会从外延式的扩张转向内涵式的发展，贷款的降速提质可能成为宏观运行的新常态之一。（新华财经）
text_en: Xie Guangqi, Director of the PBOC's Monetary Policy Department, said at a State Council Information Office press conference on the 15th that in the coming period, monetary credit will shift from extensive expansion to intensive development, and slower loan growth with improved quality may become a new normal in macro operations. (Xinhua Finance)
